Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**DEEP FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon, neutral evil*
**AC** 22 (natural armor)
**HP** 315 (18d20 + 126)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft.
**STR** 26 (+8) | **DEX** 20 (+5) | **CON** 24 (+7) | **INT** 26 (+8) | **WIS** 23 (+6) | **CHA** 23 (+6)
**Saving Throws** Dex +12, Con +14, Wis +13, Cha +13
**Skills** Perception +13, Persuasion +20, Stealth +19
**Resistances** poison
**Immunities** psychic
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, exhaustion
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., darkvision 300 ft., passive Perception 23
**Languages** Common, Draconic
**CR** 21 (33,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +7

**QUALITY TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

**TRAITS**
***Innate Spellcasting.*** The dragon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. The dragon can cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• ***At will:*** slow
• ***1/Day each:*** freedom of movement, wall of force
• ***2/Day each:*** force missile

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Uncanny Anguish.*** Psychic damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to psychic damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 22 (3d12) psychic damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Nightmare Domain or Toxic Gibberance).
• ***Nightmare Domain.*** The dragon exhales a sphere of compressed spores at a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere and spreads around corners and through spaces as tight as 1 inch wide. All creatures within range must make a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw, taking 65 (10d12) psychic damage and are frightened for 1 minute on a failed save, or half as much damage and aren’t frightened on a successful one. A frightened creature can reattempt the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.
• ***Toxic Gibberance.*** The dragon exhales a toxic gas in a 120-foot-cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or take 26 (4d12) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, a creature cannot speak properly or form the verbal components of spells. At the end of each of their turns, a poisoned creature can reattempt the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Reflecting Shield.*** When the dragon is targeted by an attack or effect, it can surround itself in a shell of psychic energy, increasing its AC by 5 until the end of the turn. If a creature hits the dragon despite this, they take 20 (3d12) psychic damage and the shell breaks, ending the effect early.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Spore Salvo (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon releases poisonous spores around a creature within 60 feet of it that it can see. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
***Cast Spell (Costs 3 Actions).*** The dragon casts a spell using its Innate Spellcasting.
